focus.title: Mastering Subject-Verb Agreement and Articles
focus.explanation: Your text demonstrates solid communicative intent, but frequent basic grammatical inaccuracies (such as 'they is', 'it make', 'people speaks', and missing articles like 'the internet' or 'a big issue') prevent your writing from progressing comfortably into the B2 band. Prioritize consistent noun-verb agreement checks and ensuring singular countable nouns have appropriate determiners.
